steps.label: Set RopePendulum preset (20-particle chain repositioned horizontally, pinned only at the start)

Precondition: chain starts flat along y=0 (pin at particle 0, tip at particle 19) -- this is exactly the always-on floor collider's height, so unlike a free-hanging pendulum this chain has no room to swing downward in Y (any downward swing is immediately blocked by the floor); only lateral (X/Z) swinging is possible, which this dispatcher has no getter for (see docs/todo/PLAN_physics_scenario_test_rebuild.md)
Change: continuing another 50 steps confirms the floor-constrained rest configuration is a stable fixed point, not just momentarily static
Invariant: pinned start did not move
Invariant: tip stays bounded near the always-on floor collider, not diverging
